mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% (as of t-1mo) is associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to compressed discount rates and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% (as of t-1mo), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A unemployment rate above 7.5% (as of t-1mo) signals labor market stress that leads to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to recessionary fears and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5% (as of t-1mo), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent 1% monthly increase in labor employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to strengthening economic growth and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and INDPRO each rise > 1% in last month
failure_condition: The interaction of PAYEMS and INDPRO rising by >1% each in last month does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% for two consecutive months), negative 60-day S&P 500 returns are expected due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts index above 900 (as of t-3mo) signals strong demand for residential construction, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns due to improved consumer confidence and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 900 (as of t-3mo), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

failure_condition: The interaction of RSAFS and INDPRO rising by >1% each in last month does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply expansion cycle (defined by INDPRO > 100 for two consecutive months), positive 60-day S&P 500 returns are expected due to rising industrial output and improved corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 235 (as of t-2mo) signals persistent inflation, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to central bank tightening and reduced risk tolerance.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235 (as of t-2mo), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
